method: Custom vectorized MC in Python. Photons: 2.5e6 histories, uniform-in-solid-angle source in the 10x10 pyramid (SSD 100), 30 cm water cube; interactions by XCOM cross sections (Klein-Nishina Compton with sampled recoil, Rayleigh, photoelectric, pair with annihilation photons); track-length estimator scored primary/scattered photon fluence spectra and angular distributions in the 1-cm-radius x 0.2-cm cylinder at 5 cm, and depth profiles for PDD. Layer 2/3 and kerma: scored fluence x mu_tr/mu_en, Compton transfer averages integrated from Klein-Nishina. Electrons: condensed-history MC (restricted collision stopping = ESTAR minus Møller delta >10 keV, Highland multiple scattering, radiative loss, delta-ray tracking) with track-length scoring for electron fluence, spectra, angular distribution, delta fraction and dose at 5 cm. K, Kcol, g from mu_tr, mu_en and radiation yields (dose=Kcol at 5 cm with small correction); s_w,air by Spencer-Attix (Delta=10 keV) with water spectrum and Bethe air stopping; PDD5 from depth profile.
data_sources: XCOM liquid-water photon cross sections (coherent, incoherent, photoelectric, pair nuclear+electron, total) as distributed with EGSnrc; ESTAR water stopping powers (collision, radiative, CSDA range, radiation yield, density-effect) as distributed with EGSnrc; Klein-Nishina and Møller/Bhabha cross sections; Highland multiple-scattering (X0=36.08 cm); Bethe stopping for air (I=85.7 eV) per TG-51.
